lines.beaver: 어서 오세요. 메뉴 여기 있어요. 천천히 보세요.
lines.beaver_en: Welcome. Here's the menu. Take your time.
lines.beaver_roman: eoseo oseyo. menyu yeogi isseoyo. cheoncheonhi boseyo.
lines.en: Thank you. It's my first time at this restaurant.

lines.beaver_en: Our pasta is really good here.
lines.en: Then I'll order one tomato pasta.

lines.beaver_en: Sure. Would you like coffee too?
Got it. Please wait a moment.
lines.en: Excuse me, does this restaurant deliver?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, we deliver. You can just order by phone.
lines.en: Nice. I like that it's quiet here.
Huh? I ordered the tomato pasta.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, I'm so sorry. Let me check.
lines.en: I think the order went in wrong.

lines.beaver: 네, 맞아요. 바로 새로 가져다 드릴게요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, you're right. I'll bring a new one right away.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, majayo. baro saero gajyeoda deurilgeyo.
lines.en: It's okay. Then please bring the coffee first.

lines.learner: 와, 커피숍 커피보다 맛있는 것 같아요.
lines.en: Wow, it seems better than coffee shop coffee.
lines.roman: wa, keopisyop keopiboda masinneun geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. Your pasta is ready too.
lines.en: Thanks for the meal. You're so kind, I'll come again.
